next_complete_deliverable.instructions: Choose the next implementation deliverable that most efficiently moves this ruleset toward a usable, complete player-facing system. Prefer a bounded code point that can be finished without a new test suite and does not assume unsupported server APIs. If the listed gaps are all too broad or depend on unverified APIs, choose defer and state the specific dependency.

criteria.finish_weapon_mastery: Complete the remaining Nick Light-weapon extra attack as part of the Attack action, respecting once-per-turn and existing weapon mastery flow. This closes the weapon-mastery implementation family but leaves broader plan gaps.
criteria.make_npc_actions_executable: Convert imported NPC stat-block actions into structured executable activities and connect them to existing NPC and encounter flows. This unlocks meaningful NPC encounters but spans importer, data contract, and UI.
criteria.complete_long_rest_state: Complete long-rest Hit Die recovery and preserve concurrent Actor changes using only Loom APIs actually supported by this ruleset. Defer any concurrency guarantee the API cannot provide.
criteria.unify_roll_application: Make every supported healing and damage flow apply the exact server-rolled result shown in chat, following existing roll APIs.
criteria.finish_multiclass_creation: Complete adding a second class through Level Up with prerequisites, class-specific progression, Hit Dice, proficiencies, spell pools, and resumable writes.
criteria.defer_for_missing_contract: None can be completed responsibly from the supplied context; state the exact missing code or Loom contract needed before implementation.
